mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings expectations upward and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint market sentiment effects.
failure_condition: The joint movement of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change < 2.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative stance supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low rates regime
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 102.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output that boosts corporate profit expectations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1.1 million units per month, it signals strong residential construction activity that stimulates consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1.1 million, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of robust job growth (PAYEMS monthly change > 100), the labor market expansion supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS monthly change exceeds 100, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
